# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [2.0.0] - 2025-12-04

### Added - Major Features
- ✨ **Route Grouping**: Automatic grouping of routes by router with tags
- ✨ **Model Support**: Auto-load model schemas from a directory
- ✨ **Model Binding**: Bind models to routers for automatic schema generation
- ✨ **Programmatic Models**: Add models programmatically with `addModel()`
- ✨ **Direct Routes Support**: Full support for both app.get() and router-based routes
- ✨ **Smart Schema Generation**: Automatic request/response schemas from models
- ✨ **Response Schemas**: GET requests now include proper response schemas
- ✨ **Custom Grouping**: Set custom group names for routers with `setGroup()`
- 🔐 **Security Schemes**: JWT, API Key, Basic Auth, and OAuth2 support
- 🌐 **Server Configuration**: Define multiple server URLs for different environments

### Features
- `modelsPath` option to auto-load models from a directory
- `bindModel(router, modelName)` to associate a model with a router
- `setGroup(router, groupName)` to set custom group names
- `addModel(name, schema)` for programmatic model registration
- `getRouteGroups()` to retrieve routes organized by group
- Enhanced route metadata tracking (group, tags, model)
- Automatic schema generation for POST, PUT, PATCH from models
- Response schema generation for GET requests
- Support for model references in schemas (`$ref`)
- Tags in OpenAPI spec for better organization
- `security` option for JWT/Bearer, API Key, Basic, and OAuth2 authentication
- `servers` option to define multiple API server URLs
- Swagger UI "Authorize" button for testing authenticated endpoints
- Security schemes automatically added to OpenAPI components

### Technical Improvements
- Enhanced RouteRegistry with model storage
- Route metadata includes group, routerPath, model, and tags
- Improved route interception with model tracking
- Better path extraction for automatic grouping
- Components/schemas section in OpenAPI spec
- Model loading from .js and .json files

### Examples
- Complete example demonstrating all features
- User, Post, and Product model examples
- Router-based routes with model binding
- Direct app routes
- Nested routers
- Custom model registration

### Breaking Changes
- None - fully backward compatible with v1.x

## [1.1.1] - 2025-10-13

### Fixed
- Fixed `config is not defined` error in route interceptor
- Improved filtering of Express internal routes (trust proxy, view engine, etc.)
- Better handling of Express configuration routes that were causing warnings

## [1.1.0] - 2025-10-13

### Added
- **Express Router Support**: Now captures routes defined on Express Router instances
- **Nested Router Support**: Handles nested routers and sub-routers
- **Path Normalization**: Proper path combining for router-mounted routes
- **Enhanced Route Tracking**: Better tracking of router-based route definitions

### Features
- Intercepts `express.Router()` constructor to track router creation
- Captures routes defined on routers before they're mounted to the app
- Automatically combines base paths with router paths (e.g., `/api/users` + `/profile` = `/api/users/profile`)
- Supports nested routers and complex routing structures
- Maintains backward compatibility with direct app routes

### Technical Improvements
- Added `normalizePath()` helper for proper path resolution
- Enhanced error handling for router interception
- Better support for complex Express.js applications using modular routing
- Improved route deduplication and validation

## [1.0.1] - 2025-10-13

### Fixed
- Updated peer dependency to support Express 5.x (`^4.0.0 || ^5.0.0`)
- Resolved dependency conflict for projects using Express 5.1.0+

## [1.0.0] - 2024-10-05

### Added
- Initial release of express-auto-swagger
- Automatic route discovery and interception for Express.js applications
- OpenAPI 3.0 specification generation
- Swagger UI integration with swagger-ui-express
- Zero-configuration setup with sensible defaults
- Configurable API title, version, and endpoint paths
- Support for all standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH)
- Automatic route parameter detection and documentation
- Real-time route discovery for dynamically added routes
- Comprehensive error handling and graceful degradation
- Route registry with duplicate prevention
- Advanced usage through returned registry and configuration objects
- Complete example applications demonstrating various usage patterns
- Full test coverage with 97 test cases
- Detailed documentation and API reference

### Features
- **Zero Configuration**: Works out of the box with `autoSwagger(app)`
- **Route Interception**: Automatically captures all Express route definitions
- **OpenAPI Generation**: Creates valid OpenAPI 3.0 specifications
- **Swagger UI**: Serves interactive API documentation
- **Parameter Detection**: Extracts route parameters (e.g., `/users/:id`)
- **Custom Configuration**: Configurable title, version, and paths
- **Error Resilience**: Graceful handling of edge cases and invalid inputs
- **Dynamic Updates**: Routes added after initialization are captured
- **Registry Access**: Advanced usage through registry manipulation
- **Standards Compliance**: Generated specs pass OpenAPI validation

### Technical Details
- Minimum Node.js version: 14.x
- Express.js compatibility: 4.x and above
- Dependencies: swagger-ui-express (automatically installed)
- Test coverage: 100% with comprehensive edge case testing
- Documentation: Complete API reference and examples

### Examples Included
- Basic REST API with CRUD operations
- Advanced configuration with custom paths and versioning
- Minimal setup demonstration
- Complex nested routes and parameter handling
- API versioning with Express routers
- Different response formats (JSON, XML, CSV)
- Authentication endpoints
- Dynamic route registration

### Breaking Changes
- None (initial release)

### Migration Guide
- None (initial release)

## Development

### Release Process
1. Update version in package.json
2. Update CHANGELOG.md with new features
3. Run full test suite: `npm test`
4. Run example applications: `npm run example`
5. Create git tag: `git tag v1.0.0`
6. Push to repository: `git push origin v1.0.0`
7. Publish to NPM: `npm publish`

### Version History
- v2.0.0: Major update with model support and route grouping
- v1.1.1: Bug fixes for Express internal routes
- v1.1.0: Express Router support
- v1.0.1: Express 5.x peer dependency support
- v1.0.0: Initial release with core functionality
